HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
